effect: Removes 1 distractor from the current MC question; a correct answer counts in combat but not for proficiency
At streak ≥ 3, a correct attack hits twice (2nd hit 50%)
First wrong block in a battle becomes a correct block (leak still applies); auto-fires if equipped and MP ≥ cost
A correct attack also freezes the target (skips its next attack)
Replaces the attack: answer one question; correct heals 30% max HP, wrong fizzles; MP spent either way
A correct attack hits all enemies at 60%
